svg.title: v1 vs v2 in Webots (replay)

g.desc: Animated replay at 30x speed of both controllers running the whole mission in Webots. v1 (original): 0/5 jars. v2 (improved): 5/5 jars, done at 738 s.

svg.text: Webots R2025a, both controllers on the same world and robot. Generated by tools/MissionReplay.java from tools/run-in-webots.sh's recordings.
